Stated Claim / Post Context:
White House hangs photos of Trump with Putin and Xi in newly remodeled room

The White House hung photos of Trump with Putin and Xi in the newly remodeled Palm Room.

Actual Article Body:
(CNN) - President Donald Trump has been involved in redecorating parts of the White House throughout his second term.

On Tuesday, the White House press corps got to see the newly remodeled Palm Room.

Gold-framed photos now on the walls of the room show Trump alongside various leaders, including Russian President Vladimir Putin, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

Other photographs show Trump alone inside the Oval Office, one of him pumping his fist as he boarded Air Force One and another of him hosting soccer star Cristiano Ronaldo.

Actual Article Body:
October 1, 2026	
	Trump Corruption, Trump Lies

The South China Morning Post reports:

Chinese President Xi Jinping has left Washington, but he still has a place at the White House. At least two, in fact. Two different photographs of Xi with US President Donald Trump feature on its walls: a handshake image that Trump showed his guest during last week’s state visit, and another beside a Palm Room doorway showing the presidents standing side by side.

Journalist Jacqueline Alemany shared an image of the Palm Room display on social media, noting that photographs of Trump with Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin lined the doorway area.

The Xi photograph sits in an ornate gold frame against a white lattice-patterned wall, beside an arched doorway and beneath a crystal chandelier. The two presidents face the camera, with Chinese and American flags behind them.
